newsitem.title: USA: Quaker Fabric files for 3.4 mln common.
newsitem.headline: Quaker Fabric files for 3.4 mln common.

text.p: Quaker Fabric Corp said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 3.4 million common shares.
Of the total, 300,000 common are being sold by the company and 3.1 million common are being offered by certain stockholders. Afer the offering, oustanding common will total 8,321,097 shares.
MLGA Fund and Nortex Holdings are the selling stockholders and are selling three million and 100,000 shares respectively, the filing said.
Net proceeds will be used to acquire production equipment to expand chenille yarn manufacturing capacity.
One of the selling stockholders has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 510,000 additional common shares.
The offering will be made through Prudential Securities Inc, The Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc and Wheat First Butcher Singer, the filing said.
Quaker, based in Fall River, Mass., is a designer, manufacturer and worldwide marketer of woven upholstery fabrics for residential furniture and a producer of Jacquard upholstery fabrics.
